attributes.name: Cauterizing Blade
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d4+2; you may additionally recharge this card to add another 1d4. If you fail this check, you may shuffle 1d4+1 random cards from your discard pile into your deck. 

On your combat check, if you played another weapon, discard this card to add 1d4+1.
